main_body: Stack of three cheese wheels: one small wheel on top of two wider wheels, all in yellow with dark brown shadow lines
top_band: x=8: row 3 outline-like #eac65a (1 row), rows 4-5 light #f4dd85 (2 rows), then the front face at rows 6-8 #e0b030. On the lower wheels the top is 1-2 rows (row 10, or rows 9-10).
evidence: Each wheel has only a 1-2 row light band on top, which reads as a thin rim rather than an ellipse of at least 4 rows. The lower wheels show a single light row (row 10 at x=5 and x=8) above a 3-row front face (rows 11-13) and a dark base row (row 14). The shape is a stack of rounded slabs seen mostly from the front. There is no clear front-edge line separating top from face; the dark rows (9, 14) are shadow lines. This is the 'rim only / thin lid' failure in the guide.

style.evidence: The candidate uses only 4 distinct colours (median 4 per tile) against 40 and 38 for the references (median 17 and 20 per tile). Its ramp is yellow, light yellow and one dark brown, so about 3 steps against roughly 5. It has no texture, no holes or rind detail and no per-wheel shading. The outline is a tinted dark brown, which is fine, but the piece is much flatter and poorer than the cheese stall reference.
